```yaml
name: Publish Skills to ClawHub

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Re-publish all skills'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

jobs:
  publish-skills:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          filter: |
            \.(md)$
            ^\.skills/
            ^skill\.md$

      - name: Setup ClawHub CLI
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/releases/download/v0.7.0/clawhub-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv clawhub /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Authenticate with ClawHub
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}" | clawhub login --token

      - name: Publish changed skills
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.added_modified != ''
        run: |
          for file in ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.added_modified }}; do
            if [[ "$file" == ".skills/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == "skill.md" ]]; then
              echo "Publishing $file"
              clawhub publish "$file" --accept-license-terms
            fi
          done

      - name: Force publish all skills
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.force == 'true'
        run: |
          find .skills -name "*.md" -type f | while read -r skill_file; do
            echo "Force publishing $skill_file"
            clawhub publish "$skill_file" --accept-license-terms
          done
          if [ -f "skill.md" ]; then
            echo "Force publishing skill.md"
            clawhub publish "skill.md" --accept-license-terms
          fi
```
